name: Rye
description: Universal Checkout API that turns any product URL into a completed order, handling price, tax, shipping and order placement so AI agents can buy from thousands of merchants.

skills.name: Check Out on Any Merchant
skills.description: Creates a checkout intent from any product URL and buyer address, then confirms it with payment to place the order.

skills.name: Buy in One Call
skills.description: Creates and confirms an order in a single request with the fire-and-forget Purchase endpoint.

skills.name: Find Promo Codes
skills.description: Scans for valid promo codes at checkout and applies them automatically to lower the final price.

skills.name: Set Price Limits
skills.description: Sets a maximum price so an order is only placed when the total falls within the agent's budget.

lifecycleNote: Acquired by Jolly Labs (Sep 2026); Universal Checkout API continues under Jolly at docs.commerce.jolly.dev.
limitations: US shipping addresses and physical products only
One product per checkout intent (no multi-product carts yet)
Guest checkout only; login-gated and anti-bot stores are unsupported
Default rate limit: 50 checkout intents/day and 10 concurrent agents
